text: Repeated positions are now judged by the rules of xiangqi instead of simply declared a draw. When a position comes up a third time, the app looks at every move of that cycle: a side that checks on every move loses by perpetual check, a side that chases a piece on every move loses by perpetual chase, and only a plain repetition is a draw. The AI avoids repetitions it would lose. The web version judges the same way, so online games agree on both sides.
重复局面现在按象棋规则判定，不再一律判和。同一局面第三次出现时，会看这一循环里的每一步：每步都在将军的一方按长将判负，每步都在捉子的一方按长捉判负，只有单纯的重复才算和棋。AI 不会走会被判负的重复着法；网页版的判法完全一样，联机对局两边看到的结果一致。
